versions.name: Fake Level Stats
versions.description: Fake likes and downloads on your levels

about:
# Fake Level Stats

With this mod, you can edit online level stats (likes, downloads and length)

You can edit it in mod settings. 

### Special thanks to [XBOCTATUK](https://github.com/XBOCTATUK) and [maskagd](https://github.com/maskagd) for helping with my ugly code
changelog:
# 1.1.5
- Fixed not updating stats when settings changed
# 1.1.4
- Fake stats updating when settings changed, or level updates
- Updated to Geode v5.10.1
# 1.1.3
- Fixed incorrect number formatting like this 

![number formatting bug](isotonicbunk.fake-online-level-stats/oops.png?height=40)
# 1.1.2
- A little bugfix.
# 1.1.1
- Reworked settings
- Auto label width
- Formating number from 1234567890 to 1,234,567,890 format
- Little changes in my ugly code
- Updated to Geode v5.7.1
# 1.1.0 
- Renamed to "Fake Level Stats"
- Code refactor:
    - Editing text, instead of creating new one
    - Сompatibility with other mods (like [Fake Rate](https://geode-sdk.org/mods/hiimjustin000.fake_rate) mod)
    - Code optimization
- Custom level length (not only Tiny - XL)
# 1.0.2 
- The mod is not replaces original text anymore, because of some problems.
# 1.0.1
- Code optimisation.
- "Show mod settings button" option is now turned on by default.
- Mod is now replacing original text, instead of hiding it.
# 1.0.0
- Fixed mod settings button position.
# 1.0.0-beta.2
- Added "-beta.x" suffix in changelog.
- Added scale modifier settings.
# 1.0.0-beta.1
- Initial version.
